first_failure.exception: ValueError: TLS manager Pod placement differs

cause: The readiness predicate treated an unbound DaemonSet replacement Pod, or a terminating predecessor overlapping its replacement, as foreign placement before checking convergence. It must validate controller ownership and any assigned node, then wait for the transition to finish. The failing callback object JSON was not captured, so these two transition cases cannot be distinguished retrospectively.

official_source.mechanism: Creates Pods with target NodeAffinity before scheduler binding and ignores terminating predecessor Pods when reconciling replacements.

deterministic_result: The original predicate fails both valid transition fixtures. The repaired predicate passes them while rejecting foreign parents, assigned foreign nodes and excess active Pods. Full security focused rerun remains required.
